about.heroSubtitle: We're on a mission to make buying and selling cars in Saudi Arabia simple, transparent, and trustworthy.
about.storyP1: Founded in 2024, WARED was created with a simple goal: to transform the car buying and selling experience in Saudi Arabia.
about.storyP2: We noticed that finding the right car was often a frustrating experience - scattered listings, unreliable sellers, and lack of transparency. We set out to change that.
about.storyP3: Today, we connect thousands of buyers and sellers across the Kingdom, providing a platform that prioritizes trust, convenience, and exceptional user experience.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about buying and selling cars on WARED.
faq.contactSupport: Our support team is here to help you with any questions.

questions.howToBuy: How do I buy a car on WARED?
questions.howToBuyAnswer: Browse our listings, use filters to find your perfect car, contact the seller, arrange a test drive, and complete the purchase directly with the seller. We facilitate the connection but the transaction is between you and the seller.
questions.isItSafe: Is it safe to buy a car online?
questions.isItSafeAnswer: We verify all sellers and listings to ensure authenticity. However, we recommend meeting in a safe public place, inspecting the car thoroughly, and completing the transaction through secure methods.
questions.canITestDrive: Can I test drive before buying?
questions.canITestDriveAnswer: Yes! We encourage test drives. Use the 'Book Test Drive' feature on any listing to schedule a viewing with the seller.
questions.howToSell: How do I list my car for sale?
questions.howToSellAnswer: Sign in to your account, click 'Sell Your Car' in the navigation, fill in your car details, upload photos, set your price, and submit. Your listing will be reviewed and published within 24 hours.
questions.listingFee: Is there a fee to list my car?
questions.listingFeeAnswer: Basic listings are free! We offer premium listing options with enhanced visibility for a small fee. Check our pricing page for details.
questions.howLongListing: How long does my listing stay active?
questions.howLongListingAnswer: Listings remain active for 30 days. You can renew or edit your listing at any time from your dashboard.
questions.createAccount: How do I create an account?
questions.createAccountAnswer: Click 'Sign Up' in the top navigation, enter your email and create a password. You can also sign up using your Google or Apple account for faster access.
questions.forgotPassword: I forgot my password. What do I do?
questions.forgotPasswordAnswer: Click 'Sign In', then 'Forgot Password'. Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
questions.deleteAccountAnswer: Yes, you can delete your account from your profile settings. Please note that this action is permanent and will remove all your listings and data.
questions.paymentMethodsAnswer: Transactions are made directly between buyers and sellers. We recommend bank transfers or cash in person. Always use secure payment methods and get receipts.
questions.platformFeesAnswer: Browsing and basic listings are free. We charge a small commission only on successful sales through our platform. Premium features may have additional fees.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using WARED, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provisions of this agreement. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our service.

services.title: 2. Description of Services
services.content: WARED provides an online marketplace platform that connects car buyers and sellers in Saudi Arabia. We facilitate listings and communications but are not a party to any transaction between users.

eligibility.title: 3. User Eligibility
eligibility.content: You must be at least 18 years old and a resident of Saudi Arabia to use our services. By using WARED, you represent that you meet these requirements.

accounts.title: 4. User Accounts
accounts.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate our terms.

listings.title: 5. Listing Guidelines
listings.content: All listings must be accurate and truthful. You may only list vehicles you have the legal right to sell. Fraudulent, misleading, or illegal listings will be removed and may result in account termination.

prohibited.title: 6. Prohibited Activities
prohibited.content: Users may not: post false or misleading information, engage in fraudulent activities, harass other users, attempt to circumvent our systems, or use the platform for any illegal purposes.

liability.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: WARED is not responsible for the quality, safety, or legality of items listed, the truth or accuracy of listings, the ability of sellers to sell items, or the ability of buyers to pay for items.

disputes.title: 8. Dispute Resolution
disputes.content: Any disputes between users should be resolved directly between the parties. WARED may provide assistance but is not obligated to mediate or resolve disputes.

modifications.title: 9. Modifications to Terms
modifications.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

contact.title: 10. Contact Information
contact.content: For questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us at legal@wared.sa or through our Contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At WARED, we take your privacy seriously. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

collection.title: 1. Information We Collect
collection.content: We collect information you provide directly (name, email, phone number, car listings), information collected automatically (IP address, browser type, device information), and information from third parties (payment processors, social login providers).

usage.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
usage.content: We use your information to: provide and improve our services, process transactions, communicate with you, personalize your experience, ensure platform security, and comply with legal obligations.

sharing.title: 3. Information Sharing
sharing.content: We may share your information with: other users (as necessary for transactions), service providers (hosting, analytics, payment processing), law enforcement (when required by law), and business partners (with your consent).

security.title: 4. Data Security
security.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encryption, secure servers, and regular security audits. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience, analyze usage patterns, and deliver personalized content. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to: access your personal data, correct inaccurate data, delete your data, object to processing, and data portability. Contact us to exercise these rights.

retention.title: 7. Data Retention
retention.content: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. We may retain certain information as required by law or for legitimate business purposes.

children.title: 8. Children's Privacy
children.content: Our services are not intended for children under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us.

international.title: 9. International Data Transfers
international.content: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than Saudi Arabia. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for such transfers.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the 'Last updated' date.

contact.title: 11. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@wared.sa or through our Contact page.

howItWorks.subtitle: From auction floor to your driveway in Saudi Arabia. Scroll to follow a real journey.
howItWorks.step01Desc: Thousands of cars from verified importers in the USA, Japan, Korea, UAE, and Germany. Filter by source, price, year, and status. Every listing shows the full landed cost.
howItWorks.step02Desc: Source price, shipping, customs duty, VAT, inspection, importer margin — every line itemized in Saudi Riyals before you commit. Nothing hidden, nothing surprises you later.
howItWorks.step03Desc: A non-refundable SAR 99 reservation fee secures your car. The importer wins the auction or buys the car from the source. This is the only fee Wared charges buyers.
howItWorks.step04Desc: From auction win to vessel departure, port arrival, customs clearance, and SASO inspection — you see every update in real time. Most cars arrive in 20–45 days.
howItWorks.faq1q: How long does importing a car take?
howItWorks.faq1a: It depends on the source country. From the USA it typically takes 45–70 days (auction → shipping → Dammam port → customs → delivery). Japan is usually 30–45 days. UAE is faster at 5–10 days. Your importer will give you a specific ETA based on vessel schedules.
howItWorks.faq2q: What are the total costs I should expect?
howItWorks.faq2a: The landed cost includes: source price (in original currency), international shipping (SAR 2,000–6,000 depending on origin), Saudi customs duty (5% of car value), VAT (15% of car + customs), port & clearance fees (~SAR 1,500–2,500), and local transportation. Every listing shows this breakdown upfront.
howItWorks.faq3q: Are all importers on this platform verified?
howItWorks.faq3a: Yes. All importers go through an application process where we verify their Commercial Registration (CR), customs broker license, and import permits. Verified importers display a 'Verified Importer' badge on their profile.
howItWorks.faq4q: What is the SAR 99 reservation fee for?
howItWorks.faq4a: The SAR 99 reservation fee holds the car for you, prevents other buyers from reserving it, and connects you directly with the importer's contact details. It is fully credited toward your final purchase price — it's not an extra charge.
howItWorks.faq5q: Can I inspect the car before it arrives in Saudi Arabia?
howItWorks.faq5a: Yes. Most importers provide pre-purchase inspection reports (Carfax, AutoCheck, auction photos and videos). Some offer third-party inspection services at the source country for an additional fee. You can also request post-arrival inspection once the car reaches the Saudi port.
howItWorks.faq6q: What happens if the car arrives with undisclosed damage?
howItWorks.faq6a: All listings must disclose salvage titles, flood damage, and frame damage. If an importer misrepresents a car's condition, you can file a dispute through our platform. We hold the reservation fee and can refund you in confirmed cases of misrepresentation.
